ideas.title: Roll for Gems
ideas.hook: Roll a giant die and smash that many rock blocks. Big rolls crack open rare gems.
core_loop: Roll the die to set how many blocks your pickaxe breaks
Break rocks and collect ores and gems
Sell gems to add new faces to your die (x2, x5, gem-only)
Rebirth for a bigger, luckier die
ideas.twist: Roll doubles and the whole mine shakes: every block on screen breaks for everyone in the server.
retention: Server leaderboard for biggest single roll
ideas.why_now: Dice/cards is the fastest-rising mechanic at 2.93× (Anime Dice, 55.6K CCU at 54 days), break/mine/dig is at 2.68× across 13 young games, and stones/ores is the top rising theme at 2.32× (+1 Stone Skipping, 25.1K). Dice × ores is the #1 gap in the data (score 9.68).
ideas.differentiator: Anime Dice rolls for characters; here the roll is a mining tool, so every result turns into a burst of breaking you can see.

ideas.title: Draw for Cars
ideas.hook: Open card packs to draw cars, then race the cars you pulled on a server track.
core_loop: Earn coins to open car card packs
Each card is a drivable car with rolled speed and handling
Race your best card in short laps for coins
Upgrade your garage to hold more cards
ideas.twist: Before each race every driver bets one card; the winner keeps the whole pot of cards.
retention: Garage you build out over time
ideas.why_now: Dice/cards (2.93×) × vehicles is the #2 gap in the data (score 9.56). Vehicles is rising at 1.41× (Firefighting Sim 16.7K, Turbo Soccer 11.3K), collect/index is at 1.79× and the "___ for ___" formula leads all titles at 3.84×.
ideas.differentiator: Card games pack cards to sit in a binder; here every card is a car you actually drive, and races decide who keeps them.

ideas.title: Fire VS Ice Cards
ideas.hook: Turn-based card duels on a board that melts and freezes. Fire cards burn ice tiles, ice cards freeze fire ones.
core_loop: Build a deck from fire, ice and storm cards
Duel players or bosses on a tile board
Win packs and craft new cards from duplicates
Climb the elemental ranked ladder
ideas.twist: The board remembers: tiles you melt or freeze stay that way, so every card changes the ground both players stand on.
ideas.why_now: Dice/cards is at 2.93× and dice × elements is a top-4 gap (score 8.89). Ice/fire/elements is the #3 rising theme at 1.98× (Firefighting Sim 16.7K, Melt All The Ice! 6.2K), turn-based RPG is the fastest-rising combat subgenre at 1.58×, and "___ vs ___" titles are up 1.39× (Ball VS Ball, 28.6K).
ideas.differentiator: Existing card battlers are anime collections; this one has no IP and makes the board itself part of the fight.

ideas.title: Dig for Records
ideas.hook: Crate-dig through a giant record store, pull rare vinyl and play it in your own club to draw a crowd.
core_loop: Dig through crates and break open sealed boxes for records
Records roll a genre and rarity
Play records in your club; dancers pay coins per song
Expand the club with bigger speakers and dance floors
ideas.twist: When two players spin the same rare record at once, both clubs merge for a server-wide dance-off.
ideas.why_now: Break/mine/dig is at 2.68× (Break and Steal an Egg 46.3K, Drill for Eggs 10.7K) and break × music is an open gap (score 5.51). Music/dance is rising at 1.37× (Trending Emote Dance 4.3K, Aura Dance Battles 4.0K) and tycoons are up 1.36× across 37 young games.
ideas.differentiator: Turns digging into crate-digging for music, so the loot is something you play, not just store.

ideas.title: +1 Style Walk
ideas.hook: Every step you strut gives +1 style. Walk farther to unlock bolder outfits and louder poses.
core_loop: Walk the street to gain +1 style per step
Spend style on outfit pieces
Each outfit multiplies your style gain
Rebirth to unlock a new city street
ideas.twist: Players you pass can tap you to rate your outfit; good ratings give you a temporary style boost.
ideas.why_now: The "+1 ___" formula is at 2.65× with 16 young games (101.9K CCU) and +1 stat × fashion is an open gap (score 5.33). Fashion/beauty is rising at 1.23× and the Dress Up subgenre at 1.21× (Makeup Mania! 9.7K, Dress Designer 8.1K).
ideas.differentiator: Dress-up games are judged on looks only; here the outfit is also your stat build, which fits the +1 grind.

ideas.title: Guess Who's Rich
ideas.hook: Everyone gets a secret fortune. Read the clues, guess who's richest and take a cut if you're right.
core_loop: Each round deals players a random secret fortune
Clues reveal one item each player owns
Vote on who the richest player is
Correct guesses earn a share of the winner's coins
ideas.twist: The poorest player can bluff; if the server picks them as richest, they win the whole pot.
ideas.why_now: Quiz/guess is rising at 1.5× (Is It Verity? 3.5K, Guess The Real Size! 2.3K) and quiz × money is the top non-dice gap (score 7.45). Money/rich is the #2 rising theme at 2.19× across 27 young games.
ideas.differentiator: Most money games are grinds; this is a fast social bluffing round where reading people matters more than playtime.

ideas.title: Forge for Goals
ideas.hook: Forge your own soccer ball with random stats, then take it into 1v1 penalty duels.
core_loop: Collect scrap from training drills
Forge balls with rolled curve, power and speed
Win penalty duels to earn rarer materials
Upgrade your forge for more slots
ideas.twist: Beat someone in a duel and you can melt their ball into yours, stealing one of its stats.
ideas.why_now: Forge/craft is rising at 1.62× (+1 Loot To Forge, 23.9K) and forge × sports is an open gap (score 5.43). Sports is up 1.33× (Ball VS Ball 28.6K, Turbo Soccer 11.3K) and hit/swing/launch is at 1.74×.
ideas.differentiator: Sports games give everyone the same ball; here crafting decides your shot, so every duel is gear vs gear.

ideas.title: Build a Snow Fort
ideas.hook: Build an ice fort that makes snowballs, then launch them to raid other forts for their loot.
core_loop: Pack snow into blocks and build your fort
Fort machines make snowballs and coins over time
Launch snowballs at other forts to break walls
Raid broken forts for coins and rare ice blocks
ideas.twist: A heatwave every few minutes melts the weakest walls on the map, opening surprise raid windows.
ideas.why_now: "Build a ___" titles are up 1.56× (Build the Pyramid! 13.6K) and tycoons 1.36× across 37 young games. Ice/fire is rising at 1.98× and steal × tycoon is a proven pair (9 young games, 34.7K CCU).
ideas.differentiator: Raiding is usually walking into a base; here you knock it down from range first, so defense means building smart walls.

ideas.title: Survive the Scrapyard
ideas.hook: Zombies rise from a junkyard each night. Smash cars for scrap by day, forge weapons, last the night.
core_loop: Break wrecked cars and machines for scrap
Forge weapons and barricades with rolled stats
Hold the yard against zombie waves at night
Each survived night unlocks deeper parts of the yard
ideas.twist: A giant car crusher sits in the middle; lure zombies into it for bonus scrap.
ideas.why_now: Forge/craft is at 1.62× and break/mine/dig at 2.68×. "Survive ___" titles are up 1.11× (Survive a Million Monkeys 19.2K, Survive Deep in the Woods 5.0K), zombies are rising at 1.16× (Build and Kill Zombies 8.9K) and it lands in October.
ideas.differentiator: Zombie defense games hand you guns; here your whole arsenal comes from what you break and forge each day.

ideas.title: Brush for Fossils
ideas.hook: Brush dig sites for fossil bones, roll their rarity and rebuild living dinosaurs for your park.
core_loop: Dig and brush sites to uncover bones
Each bone rolls a rarity and mutation
Complete a skeleton to bring that dinosaur to life
Dinos roam your park and earn coins from visitors
ideas.twist: Brush too hard and the bone cracks; a steady brush keeps the roll's luck boost.
ideas.why_now: Break/mine/dig is at 2.68× and RNG roll at 1.75× (Anime Dice 55.6K, THRESHOLD 9.2K). Dinosaurs are rising at 1.18× (Prehistoric Farm 3.2K, +1 Dino Evolution 0.7K) and break × collect pairs already hold 46.3K young CCU.
ideas.differentiator: Dino games start you with a dinosaur; here you earn each one bone by bone, which gives the RNG a long, visible payoff.
